en-US.description: Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
en-US.longDescription: Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
en-US.name: codeg
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release makes task delivery easier, improves long conversations and desktop memory cleanup, fixes GitLab image previews, and updates agents and built-in skills.
New
- Include uncommitted task changes when creating or updating a PR/MR, with a file list and editable commit message before committing and pushing to the task branch.
Improved
- Streaming replies and long execution histories are more responsive, with steps loading as you scroll and fewer blank areas, missing steps or unexpected scroll jumps in chat and sub-agent panels.
- Built-in expert skills are updated to Superpowers 7.0.2, improving plan execution when skills are installed individually.
- Built-in research skills are updated to scientific-agent-skills 2.72.0, expanding paper lookup to 18 scholarly sources and improving data analysis, scientific figures and research reviews.
- Updated CodeBuddy to 2.184.0, Kimi Code to 2.6.1, Qoder to 1.1.88 and Antigravity to 1.5.0.
Fixed
- Reduced memory retained after closing desktop conversation tabs or sub-agent panels while they are still loading, and fixed cases where reopening a conversation could remain stuck waiting. (#1148 by @kogekiplay)
- GitLab issue and comment images display correctly across desktop, Web and remote workspaces, including private uploads and images hosted in object storage.
- CodeBuddy file previews no longer include extra reading hints as file content, keeping the displayed content and line numbers accurate.
Thanks to @kogekiplay for contributing to this release.

zh-CN.description: 在一个地方聚合并浏览 AI 编程代理会话（如 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等）。支持桌面应用、自建服务器或 Docker 部署。
zh-CN.longDescription: Codeg（Code Generation，代码生成）是一款企业级多代理编码工作区。它将本地 AI 编程代理（包括 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、OpenClaw、Cline 等）统一集成于桌面应用、独立服务器或 Docker 容器中，支持通过任意浏览器进行远程开发；具备对话聚合、并行 Git 工作树开发、MCP/技能管理、聊天频道交互（Telegram、飞书、iLink 等），以及集成的 Git/文件/终端工作流。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
这一版让任务交付更方便，提升长对话的响应与滚动体验，减少桌面端关闭会话后的内存残留，修复 GitLab 图片预览，并更新多个智能体及内置技能。
新增
- 创建或更新任务 PR/MR 时，可以一并提交任务工作区中尚未提交的改动，交付前可查看文件清单并编辑提交信息。
改进
- 长回复和大量工具调用时，内容更新与滚动更加流畅，执行步骤随滚动加载，并减少聊天与子智能体面板中的空白、步骤漏显和位置跳动。
- 内置专家技能更新至 Superpowers 7.0.2，改善单独安装技能时的计划执行体验。
- 内置科研技能更新至 scientific-agent-skills 2.72.0，论文检索扩展至 18 个学术来源，并改进数据分析、科研绘图与学术评审流程。
- CodeBuddy 更新至 2.184.0，Kimi Code 更新至 2.6.1，Qoder 更新至 1.1.88，Antigravity 更新至 1.5.0。
修复
- 减少桌面端关闭仍在加载的会话标签页或子智能体面板后的内存残留，并修复关闭后重新打开会话可能一直等待的问题。（#1148 by @kogekiplay）
- GitLab Issue 和评论中的图片可在桌面端、Web 端及远程工作区正常显示，兼容私有上传和对象存储中的图片。
- CodeBuddy 文件预览不再将额外的读取提示混入文件内容，确保内容与行号正确显示。
感谢 @kogekiplay 为本次发布做出的贡献。
